name: Embracing Escape
source:
Vick, a well-off scavenger, happens to find a state-of-the-art VR headset from a dead man in a crash accident. What is in store for Vick in this cyberpunk world, and how would entering VR change her? 

[From [url=https://algrostudio.itch.io/embracingescape]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
维克是一位富裕的拾荒者，他偶然从一场车祸中的死者身上发现了一台最先进的VR耳机。在这个赛博朋克世界中，Vick将会面临什么？进入VR将如何改变她？

[来自[url=https://algrostudio.itch.io/embracingescape]itch.io[/url]]
